content: Arrowhead Regional Medical Center (ARMC) is a hospital situated in Colton, California, within the Inland Empire region of Southern California. The hospital is under the leadership of Dr. Dev GnanaDev. Arrowhead Regional Medical Center is widely recognized and highly esteemed as a prominent medical research institution in Southern California. The hospital's infrastructure is designed to withstand seismic events, utilizing advanced engineering techniques. Specifically, it employs a combination of elastomeric base isolators and hydraulic viscous dampers, which are similar to those used in MX missile silos. These systems are engineered to absorb the energy generated during an earthquake, thereby preserving the structural integrity of the building. ARMC was one of the first hospitals in the United States to implement a hospital-wide filmless radiology system. This innovative system produces digital imaging, which can be instantly accessed at multiple workstations throughout the facility. This technology enables faster and more precise diagnostic processes, significantly enhancing patient care.
